prompt: A biomechanical falcon in mid-dive, a cutaway diagram revealing the internal mechanical structure, in the hybrid style of Kow Yokoyama, Katsuhiro Otomo, and Moebius. The wings are spread wide, composed of layered alloy feathers with visible mechanical joints and internal circuitry. Rendered with fine ink lines, cross-hatching, and vivid color panels, creating a balance of power and elegance. Surrounded by blueprint-style annotations, numbers, and schematic symbols, presented as a detailed engineering illustration on white paper.
